mapper.select: SELECT mission_id AS id , mission_id AS mission_id , title , description , mission_type , trigger_event , target_count , reward_point , place_keyword , max_total_cost , auto_complete , start_at , end_at , created_at FROM `mission` ORDER BY mission_id DESC

SELECT mission_id AS id , mission_id AS mission_id , title , description , mission_type , trigger_event , target_count , reward_point , place_keyword , max_total_cost , auto_complete , start_at , end_at , created_at FROM `mission` WHERE mission_id = #{missionId}

SELECT id AS user_mission_id , user_id , mission_id , current_count , progress , status , reward_received , completed_at , created_at , updated_at FROM `mission_progress` WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND mission_id = #{missionId}
mapper.update: UPDATE `mission_progress` SET reward_received = TRUE , completed_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) , updated_at = CURRENT_TIMESTAMP(6) WHERE id = #{userMissionId}

UPDATE `mission`
title = #{title},
description = #{description},
mission_type = #{missionType},
trigger_event = #{triggerEvent},
target_count = #{targetCount},
reward_point = #{rewardPoint},
auto_complete = #{autoComplete},
place_keyword = #{placeKeyword},
max_total_cost = #{maxTotalCost},
start_at = #{startAt},
end_at = #{endAt},
WHERE mission_id = #{id}
